method.title: 3 · Farming method & crops
method.whyHint: Ranked by where each crop is actually grown in India (district crop statistics). Hover a crop to see why.
method.whyHintRules: Multi-layer suggestions use expert crop ranges with seasonal temperatures — the district crop statistics don't cover multi-layer systems. Hover a crop to see why.
method.expertGroup: Other crops — expert ranges (not in the district crop statistics):

monoculture.name: Single crop
monoculture.desc: One crop across the whole field — paddy, wheat, cotton and other staples. Simplest to manage.

intercrop.name: Intercropping
intercrop.desc: 2–3 crops in alternating row bands — spreads risk and lifts income; legumes feed the soil.

multilayer.name: Multi-layer
multilayer.desc: Up to 5 vertical layers on the same land — highest income per acre, more labour and skill.
